Ingredients of soft drinks
13.1 Introduction 
The main ingredients in the soft drinks are water, sweeteners, acidulants, 
colorants, flavours and clouding agents.
13.2 Water
Water is the major component of soft drink. A carbonated soft drink usually 
contains 82–97% water. The quality of the water used in a beverage has a 
critical impact on the taste, appearance, physical and microbiological stability.
